content: Class 8 EV energy modeling platforms use hybrid architectures: web UI (React/Next) for scenario config and map viz, Python microservice for physics/spatial compute, PostGIS for charger/corridor spatial queries, self-hosted truck routing (Valhalla preferred), and async job queues (Celery+Redis) for simulation workloads. NREL FASTSim is reference for HDV validation but segment-based custom models fit corridor planning tools better.
